title: Distilling Lexical Product Associations into Deep Transformers: An Extreme Multi-Label Approach for Natural Language E-Commerce Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.26921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional e-commerce search platforms rely heavily on inverted indices and token-level lexical matching algorithms (e.g., BM25 and TF-IDF), which frequently fail on conversational, intent-driven, or paraphrased user queries -- the classic vocabulary mismatch problem. We formulate conversational product recommendation as an Extreme Multi-Label Classification (XMLC) problem over an e-commerce catalog of N = 54,000 products spanning 27 balanced retail categories from the Amazon Reviews '23 benchmark. Using a pre-trained DistilBERT transformer encoder, we distill dense item-to-item similarity topologies (generated via TF-IDF cosine similarity over cumulative metadata with K = 50 nearest neighbours) into a deep contextual representation via a pseudo-label knowledge distillation framework. translated_title: 将词汇级产品关联蒸馏到深度Transformer中：一种面向自然语言电商搜索的极端多标签方法
translated_abstract: 传统电商搜索平台严重依赖倒排索引和词级词汇匹配算法（如BM25和TF-IDF），这些算法在会话式、意图驱动或改述表达的用户查询上经常失效——这就是经典的词汇不匹配问题。我们将对话式产品推荐表述为一个极端多标签分类（XMLC）问题，处理对象是来自Amazon Reviews '23基准数据集的电商目录，涵盖N=54,000个产品、27个均衡的零售类别。使用预训练的DistilBERT Transformer编码器，我们通过伪标签知识蒸馏框架，将密集的商品间相似度拓扑结构（通过对累积元数据计算TF-IDF余弦相似度生成，K=50个最近邻）蒸馏到深层上下文表示中。在严格的85/15训练/验证集划分上（在C=53,923个输出类别中对8,089个保留产品进行测试）并强制执行自我排除的条件下进行评估……
tldr: 该论文提出一种伪标签知识蒸馏框架，将基于TF-IDF的产品关联拓扑蒸馏进DistilBERT编码器，把对话式电商搜索转化为5.4万商品规模上的极端多标签分类任务，从而克服传统词汇匹配的词汇不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper frames conversational e-commerce search as an extreme multi-label classification task over 54,000 products and distills TF-IDF-based product association topologies into a DistilBERT encoder via pseudo-label knowledge distillation to overcome the classic vocabulary mismatch problem.
